Name: (CP) Trellis as Fruit Trees
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]This mod adds Trellis for Morning Glory as Fruit Trees. 

[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
3. Download and unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.



[img]https://abload.de/img/button3bljhi.png[/img]

You can buy the Trellis at Pierre's Shop.
When you harvest the Trellis you receive Pink, Purple, Red or Mixed Morning Glory.
Morning Glory can be turned into Wine or Jelly. 
You can also eat them.


[b][size=3]A preview of the grow cycle:[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tv0lXKy.png[/img]﻿

﻿[/center]
